verdict.rationale: The PlayCanvas Engine is open source (MIT) and installable from npm, and can be scaffolded and run as standalone local projects. Paid plans also offer "Download Apps for Self-hosting" for published builds. However, the Editor, which carries the visual and collaborative product and the MCP integration, runs only in the browser with work saved to PlayCanvas's cloud, and community users report code living on PlayCanvas servers with no offline editor. Missing for 10: a self-hostable or offline Editor/backend, documentation for deploying the full platform on your own infrastructure, and self-hosting of exported apps on the free tier.
